scripts.build: npm run build -w @whoami/shared && npm run build -w @whoami/server && npm run build -w @whoami/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @whoami/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @whoami/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @whoami/server" "npm run dev -w @whoami/client"
